title: Cragmaw Castle · Area 8 · Dark hall

sourceRecords.title: Area 8 · Dark hall and grick
read: A narrow, lightless hall bears carvings that do not match its current occupants. Heavy curtains hang to the north, and a stone brazier stands between them.

The carvings reward a closer look, but the curtains prevent you from seeing the spaces beyond them. The stone brazier is a visible landmark between those covered openings. You can study the workmanship, listen toward the cloth, or decide whether to move farther into the hall.

brief: High narrow former chapel hall, sculpted ANGELIC figures along upper walls. TWO north archways covered by heavy curtains, cracked ornate stone brazier BETWEEN them. No exterior light; off-frame visitor lantern. Hidden grick remains invisible in upper statuary, gold statuette remains buried beneath coals. No active glowing altar or cultists.
